name: gizza-ai/string-escaper
summary: Escape or unescape a string for a chosen target syntax

tool.description: Escape (or unescape) a string for a chosen target syntax: JSON, JavaScript, HTML, URL, shell, SQL, or regex. mode=escape (default) or mode=unescape; unescape works for json/javascript/html/url only. Set quotes=true to wrap json/javascript/sql output in surrounding quotes.
